# OpenLayers 10.11.0

Vendored browser distribution, CSS, and BSD-2-Clause license from the official
`ol` npm package, mirrored by jsDelivr:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ol@10.11.0/ol.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ol@10.11.0/LICENSE.md

These files are served locally. The app does not contact jsDelivr at runtime.
`SHA256SUMS` records the checked-in files. No package manager is needed to build
or run the demo. Upgrade the files, version, checksums, and license together.
